newsitem.title: USA: Nutrition For Life says SEC probe over.
newsitem.headline: Nutrition For Life says SEC probe over.

text.p: Nutrition For Life International Inc said Wednesday that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission had terminated its investigation of the company and that no enforcement action had been recommended to the commission.
The company said in a release that its "distributors and shareholders can be confident of the integrity of the Nutrition For Life International marketing plan."
The company said it was notified in April 1996 that the commission was conducting a private investigation to determine whether it had violated the federal securities laws.
David Bertrand, president and chief executive officer, said in the release that the company "consistently believed" in the legality of its plan.
He added that it has "one of the few network marketing plans in the country that has been subjected to the scrutiny of major federal and state regulatory bodies with no action taken."
